configs.name: SX
configs.description: Start a fake chademo charging, then wait for ccs to join. Should work better with Xpeng and Lexus.

configs.name: V2X
configs.description: V2X mode permanently enabled. Should work equally well for charging, but some cars may not like it (speculation).

configs.name: V2X-AO
configs.description: Always on. After inactivity or charging ended, do a soft restart instead of shutting down. When battery drops below 3.3V, it will power off instead. Errors and stop buttons will power off, as usual.

configs.name: AV1
configs.description: For target voltage 410v, use nominal voltage 380v instead of 355v. AV1 should be a better match for Leaf/e-NV200 with 20-30kwh battery.

configs.name: C09
configs.description: Emulate chademo 0.9 without welding detection (default: chademo 1.0 with welding detection). Probably better for sensitive cars like Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV that produce DTC's (P101B, P101C) after charging is done.

settings.max-amps: Maximum available charging current (A) reported to the car. This indirectly limits the charging current by making the car ask for less.
settings.stop-charging-soc: Adapter will stop charging when SOC (reported by car) reaches N%.
settings.max-volts: Maximum charging voltage (V) reported to the car. Porsche Taycan requires 750V, but 750V may break compatibility with many chargers. 500V is a good default.
settings.max-discharge-amps-fallback: If the car reports a maximum discharge current, the car takes precedence. Else the fallback value is used as maximum discharge current.
settings.dynamic-current-fallback: Controls whether available current is allowed to change while charging. If the car declares that it allows it, the car takes precedence. Else the fallback value is used.
settings.sx: Start a fake chademo charging, then wait for CCS to join. Should work better with Xpeng and Lexus.
settings.v2x: Sends and handles the 0x20*-series of chademo bidirectional charging messages. Charging should work equally well, but some cars may not like it (speculation).
settings.always-on: After inactivity or charging ended, do a soft restart instead of shutting down. Below 3.3V battery it powers off. Errors and stop buttons power off, as usual.
settings.voltage-estimation-mode: 0 = default. 1 = for target voltage 410V use nominal voltage 380V instead of 355V (better match for Leaf/e-NV200 with 20-30kWh battery).
settings.assume-car-contactors-closed-after-ms: Time (ms) after which the adapter assumes the car's contactors are closed. Worst case seen in logs is 1600ms before the car asks for amps, but the default is 2000ms.
settings.fake-idle-amps: Fake output current (A) reported to the car, when no current is flowing. In theory, this may prevent the car from thinking charging is done and stopping the charging.
settings.voltage-modulation: Modulates the voltage reported to the car by +-N Volt every 100ms. 0 = off (default). Added to prevent voltage deviation error, by tricking the car into thinking the voltage is (periodically) within range. The error no longer happens.
settings.precharge-start-delay-ms: Delay (ms) before CCS precharge starts. 2000ms should be a safe default. In very special edge cases, some chargers could benefit from a higher value (e.g. 3000ms), but you would need to be an expert to know.
settings.max-undersupply-amps: Maximum allowed difference (undersupply) of output current compared to request current. If the difference is larger, available output current is reduced to (output current + N).
settings.chademo-wd: Enable welding detection. Required by chademo 1.x, optional in 0.9.
settings.chademo-0.9: Simulate chademo 0.9 instead of 1.0. Welding detection is optional in chademo 0.9.
settings.open-adapter-contactor-before-wd: Open the adapter contactor before welding detection. Pro: voltage drops consistently and does not depend on the charger's bleed-down speed. Con: the inlet may not bleed down at all (spec demands <1uF, but charge could be trapped).
settings.exi-logging: Log the EXI messages exchanged with the charger (debugging).
settings.max-report-soc: SOC reported to the charger is scaled from chademo's 0-100% to 0-N%.
